meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 在容器里装上 mnemon 并注册 Claude Code 钩子:Claude 回应前会自动调出以往相关的上下文,每轮结束再存下新结论。记忆写入按 agent 分组的 .claude/ 目录,容器重启后仍在。
howto.when: 在跑默认 Claude provider 的 agent 组上用(container.json 里 provider 缺失或为 claude)。若该组设了别的 provider,它不会调用 claude CLI,钩子也就不运行。

say.text: 帮我给这个 agent 组装上 mnemon 持久记忆
确认 mnemon 钩子已经注册好了
测试一下 mnemon 能不能想起上一次会话聊的内容
say.note: 新开会话引用旧内容,看它是否自动调出。

howto.what_en: Installs mnemon in the agent container and registers Claude Code hooks: Claude recalls relevant past context before responding and stores new insights after each turn. Memory sits in the per-agent-group .claude/ mount.
howto.when_en: Use on agent groups running the default Claude provider (provider key absent or "claude"). Hooks only fire under --target claude-code, so groups with another provider don't run them.

say_en.text: Install mnemon persistent memory for this agent group
say_en.note: Runs pre-flight, edits Dockerfile and entrypoint, rebuilds the image.

say_en.text: Confirm the mnemon hooks are registered
say_en.note: Checks container logs and settings.json for mnemon.

say_en.text: Test whether mnemon recalls the earlier session
say_en.note: Start a new session and reference old context.
